name: g1-check
description: step G1 books check: 420 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit; springs; the gene set high for all (costs), N, a wash, null / off / on / cost x5 / beyond 0 and 1 toggled at runtime, a resize with G (wild founders), sloppy -2 then careful 3, key M off and on, turnover mode and back, a snapshot saved and loaded (300 s): atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'oil', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.3, 'linker', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.3, 'ions', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 1e9); if (!moire.oases.started) moire.oases.start(); return moire.matter.springs.map(s => s.kind)

const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 400); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'emulsion', 300); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.4, 'soap', 200); return 'springs again'
moire.genome.rules.mut = true; await moire.genome.setAll({fidelity: 3}); return 'key M on, careful 3'
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }

const c = await moire.fidelity.now(); return JSON.stringify({t: c.time, n: c.n, mean: c.mean, sd: c.sd, above: c.above, below: c.below, lit: c.lit, shade: c.shade, hard: c.hard, interior: c.interior, edge: c.edge, loner: c.loner, kin: c.kin, lineages: c.lineages, copy: c.copy})
